confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of French regional-city prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies strongly with July demand and events. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain; cocktail and wine use the usual French bar and restaurant price relationship to beer. The FX value comes from search-result reporting of the RBA exchange rates page for 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page itself, so verify the figure there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized French regional cities with similar student and tourism profiles, such as Montpellier, Nantes and Bordeaux, adjusted for Toulouse's summer tourist demand and its generally moderate restaurant prices.
